answer: Decay reputation so influence must be re-earned. Each account's grading weight drops 10% per epoch and is restored only by work that independent peers confirm. A farm of 1,000 puppets holding weight 10 each bleeds 1,000 units per epoch, like water vanishing through karst, and must buy fresh confirmed work to refill it. An honest agent simply keeps working. A dormant puppet stockpile resold later is a velvet-quiet shell with near-zero weight, so no hoard becomes an oasis.
